general.fonts_info: This theme uses the brand's licensed typefaces (Grotesk, Montreal, Supply) directly. They're fixed, and not editable here.

labels.menu_info: Optional. Leave blank to use the drop/lookbook/studio anchor links built into this shop.
labels.timezone_info: IANA timezone identifier, e.g. Europe/Copenhagen. Leave blank to show the visitor's local time.
labels.heading: Heading
labels.heading_cn_info: Set with the Noto Sans TC face, after the English heading. Leave blank to omit.
labels.aspect_ratio_info: A CSS aspect-ratio value, e.g. 4/3 or 16/9.
labels.anchor_id_info: Used for menu links that jump to this section, e.g. #drop.
labels.deadline_info: ISO 8601 with an offset, so there is no timezone ambiguity. For example: 2026-11-27T00:00:00+01:00
labels.show_notify_form_info: Creates a real, marketing-consented customer record on submit via Shopify's native customer form.
labels.show_confetti: Show confetti on scroll into view
labels.digit_size_info: A multiplier against one percent of the usable grid width, the same mechanism the display headline uses.
labels.escalate: Escalate the theme as it approaches
labels.escalate_info: The section changes its own colour pair as the deadline nears.
labels.soon_hours: Hours before switching to the second theme
labels.final_minutes: Minutes before switching to the final theme
labels.favicon_info: Displayed at 32x32px in the browser tab.
labels.free_shipping_threshold_info: In your store's currency, e.g. 600. Used by the cart drawer's progress bar.
